name: Mauka Cycling Club
description: Local Oahu club focused on community rides, fitness, and aloha. Sunday rides and weekday options. Strong emphasis on welcoming new riders.
contact: via local rides or club organizers

name: Hawai'i Bicycling League (HBL)
description: Hawaii's primary bicycle advocacy and education organization. Runs the Honolulu Century Ride, weekly group rides, BikeEd programs, and infrastructure advocacy.

name: Oahu Cycling Club (OCC)
description: Active Facebook-based group for coordinating times, locations, coffee jams, and small group rides across Oahu.

name: Tradewind Cycling Team
description: Competitive cycling team with race calendar, training rides, and events across the islands.

name: Hawaii Cycling Club
location: Primarily Big Island (Hilo / Kona) with some statewide events
description: Long-standing club with weekly group rides and organized events. Strong presence on Hawai'i Island.
